title: Lookup Option
description: One value in a generic reference-data list (status/category/priority/mode/etc.), keyed by listKey. Matches public.lookup_options. Replaced hardcoded enum columns across nearly every other table (migrations 0008-0011) -- any *_id field elsewhere in this schema set that says 'FK -> lookup_options.id, list_key = X' draws its valid values from the rows here where listKey = X, not from a fixed schema enum. Current listKeys in use: asset_category, asset_request_priority, asset_request_status, bom_status, budget_period, budget_status, contractor_license_category, contractor_specialty, funding_source, milestone_status, post_qualification_result, post_qualification_status, procurement_activity_status, procurement_category, procurement_item_status, procurement_mode, project_status, purchase_order_status, requisition_status, risk_category, risk_impact, risk_probability, risk_severity, risk_status, risk_type. Two listKeys (bidding_activity_status, rfq_status) are orphaned leftovers from the retired Vendor Bidding module (migration 0041 dropped the columns that referenced them but not the lookup_options rows themselves) -- candidates for cleanup, not currently referenced by any FK.
